body.x: INTERLINE will participate in the world’slargest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 toshowcase its eyewear shopping service FITTING MONSTER.

Fitting Monster is an eye share shopping service equipped with AI fitting solution developed by Interline. Users can put on glasses virtually on their faces when shopping online, solving the inconvenience of not being able to try the glasses at the existing eyewear online shopping mall.

Using the fitting monster is simple. Install Fitting Monster, and after signing up, recognize your face with the camera and scan according to the guide. It is a video recording method that scans a face instead of the conventional live method, so even low vision users can check the exact virtual fitting of left and right 60 degrees, and virtually fit the whole product with a single scan, expanding the choice.

Interline is an app & web solution andservice development company established in 2015, and is developing newdistribution methods through domestic and international business through ARtechnology development, and by developing new technologies such as lenses,jewelry, and hair as well as eyewear, virtual fitting shopping area will beexpanded.
Fitting Monster is available for downloadfrom the Google Play Store and will be available soon in the App Store.
